objective: Add Langfuse-compatible AI tracing with a no-op local fallback, persist trace IDs for /ask-sage and daily content drafts, and prove the traced flows end to end.
deliverables: Added lib/ai/observability.ts with Langfuse SDK initialization, local fallback trace IDs, child observations, flushing, and sensitive payload redaction.
Wrapped DeepSeek chat calls as generation observations.
Wrapped RAG retrieval and RAG answer generation under a root chain observation.
Persisted AI trace metadata into rag_retrieval_logs.metadata, rag_answers.metadata, and daily draft metadata.
Updated /ask-sage, daily planner, and RAG smoke evidence to require trace IDs.
Added unit coverage for local fallback trace IDs and redaction.

mode.reason: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY were not configured in the local environment. The Langfuse export path is installed and wired, but cloud export was not claimed as proven.
mode.fallbackBehavior: AI flows still emit non-empty trace IDs and observation IDs and persist them to evidence/database metadata.

tsc --noEmit passed after the final smoke-evidence change.

nextPhase: Phase 2 - formal RAG evaluation harness, golden questions, answer scoring, regression gates, and trace-linked eval runs.
